name: Whimsical
summary: Playful and light: round letters, a script word, little stars, things that tilt and bounce.
css: .title::before, .title::after, .title .tl:last-child::after { content: ""; position: absolute; background: @light; clip-path: polygon(50% 0,61% 35%,98% 35%,68% 57%,79% 91%,50% 70%,21% 91%,32% 57%,2% 35%,39% 35%); filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25)); }
.title::before { width: 96px; height: 96px; left: 70px; top: -70px; transform: rotate(-14deg); }
.title::after { width: 64px; height: 64px; right: 96px; top: -34px; transform: rotate(12deg); background: @pop; }
.title .tl:last-child::after { width: 52px; height: 52px; right: 60px; bottom: -58px; transform: rotate(-8deg); }
.tag, .cta { color: @main; border: 6px solid #fff; transform: rotate(-3deg); padding: 14px 40px; }
